reviews.title: Great app for the price
reviews.text: This is a great app. Interface is straight forward, love the pomodoro and monthly stats feature. Very easy to use for habit tracking. -1 star though because even though it claims otherwise, it doesn’t work for habits that are more or less than daily. Also would be willing to pay up to 4.99 a month for more features, e.g. folders for sorting habits, daily journal prompts.

reviews.title: Love the colorful, simple interface. Missing a few key functionalities.
reviews.text: I’ve used a few habit tracking apps and this is my favorite interface that I’ve seen. I love that it’s clean, colorful and easy to read. Great work! Would love to keep using it but definitely missing a few functions that I’ve seen in other apps that would be useful: - Being able to check off a habit multiple times in one day (for instance, for medicine that needs to be taken morning and night) - Being able to duplicate already created habits so as not to have to set all parameters from scratch - Being able to click through the calendar to see habit/task lists on different days - Being able to sort habits by time of day (morning vs evening for example) - Being able to set the time increment to “weeks” or “months” for habits. Currently, everything is by days so a weekly habit must be set to every “7 days”, which isn’t totally intuitive.
